tiers.everyday: The Bolshoy Uspensky (Great Assumption) bell is the largest bell in the Kremlin's working bell-tower ensemble. It was cast in 1817 and is 4.2 m across.
tiers.student: The Kremlin Museums record dates the bell to 1817, names masters Yakov Zavyalov and Rusinov at Mikhail Bogdanov's plant, and gives a diameter of 4200 mm. Mass is not in the record [UNKNOWN].
